summary: Iteration 50 - Atomic Payment Claim Fix Testing. Verified the fix for race condition between webhook and status-polling that was causing double-crediting. All 25 backend tests passed. The atomic claim implementation using MongoDB's findOneAndUpdate with {applied: {$ne: True}} condition is correctly implemented in both /api/payments/status and /api/webhook/stripe endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Atomic claim implemented correctly using MongoDB's find_one_and_update with {applied: {$ne: True}} condition at lines 4428-4442 (payment_status) and 4538-4546 (webhook)
GOOD: Both endpoints use the same atomic pattern ensuring only one caller (webhook OR poll) wins the race and credits coins
GOOD: Response contract includes 'coins' field as specified (line 4464)
GOOD: _apply_payment_success has idempotency check at line 4300: if tx.get('payment_status') == 'paid' and tx.get('applied'): return
GOOD: Frontend PaymentSuccess.jsx starts polling immediately (line 37: poll() called without initial delay)
GOOD: Progressive backoff implemented: 1s for first 6 attempts, 2s for next 12, 3s after (line 31)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 50 tested the atomic payment claim fix.
